## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 20% | 0.2% | not applicable | 0% |

Latvia holds four acts (Satversme, Krimināllikums, Darba likums, Fizisko personu datu apstrādes likums) with accurate in-force history, but of the six essentials it holds only the Satversme and the Krimināllikums: Civillikums, Civilprocesa likums, Kriminālprocesa likums and Administratīvā procesa likums are missing. The Krimināllikums is one version behind: the version likumi.lv has in force since 2026-11-05 (law of 15.10.2026) is not in the repository. That is 4 of about 1,700 base laws in force, with no case law.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
